# hypjam

> hypjam is a new UGC (user-generated content) ad agency based in London, founded by Avi
> Aggarwal. We brief, cast, direct and edit short-form creator ads for TikTok, Instagram
> Reels, YouTube Shorts and other platforms, then clear usage rights in writing and report
> back. hypjam has no clients yet. Packages start from £1,800 a month.

## About

- [Home](https://hypjam.com/): What hypjam does, for brands and for creators.
- [Agency](https://hypjam.com/agency): The London UGC agency behind the creators, founded by Avi Aggarwal.
- [Process](https://hypjam.com/process): How a brief runs week by week, and the three packages — Starter from £1,800/mo, Growth from £3,600/mo, Scale from £6,500/mo.
- [Rights](https://hypjam.com/rights): Usage rights in writing, signed creator releases, ASA/CAP disclosure compliance and UK GDPR data handling.
- [FAQ](https://hypjam.com/faq): Answers for brands hiring hypjam and for creators joining the roster.

## Services

Nine services covering every part of a UGC ad, from brief to report. Every service page links back to [Services](https://hypjam.com/services).

- [Services overview](https://hypjam.com/services)
- [Briefing & scripts](https://hypjam.com/services/briefing): One brief, one locked script, one shot list.
- [Hook writing](https://hypjam.com/services/hooks): Eight opening lines per script, written word for word.
- [Casting & roster](https://hypjam.com/services/casting): Casting for fit from hypjam's own creator roster, approved by the brand.
- [Shoot direction](https://hypjam.com/services/shoot-direction): Every take directed against the script, with notes.
- [Editing & captions](https://hypjam.com/services/editing): Platform-native cuts with captions, one revision round included.
- [Whitelisting & Spark Ads](https://hypjam.com/services/whitelisting): Creator-handle ads, authorised and dated before launch.
- [Usage rights](https://hypjam.com/services/usage-rights): Every platform and every day of use, in writing.
- [Reporting](https://hypjam.com/services/reporting): A live tracker, then a written debrief.
- [Founder-led video](https://hypjam.com/services/founder-led): Founders directed on camera, like a roster creator.

## Solutions

hypjam mapped onto a brand's goal and brand type. Every solutions page links back to [Solutions](https://hypjam.com/solutions).

- [Solutions overview](https://hypjam.com/solutions)
- [Launches](https://hypjam.com/solutions/launches): Hooks, casting and first cuts ready before the product ships.
- [Always-on paid social](https://hypjam.com/solutions/always-on-paid-social): A monthly supply of ads, briefed, cast, cut and whitelisted.
- [Organic & trends](https://hypjam.com/solutions/organic-and-trends): Trend-led content, briefed this week, shot on a phone.
- [Founder-led](https://hypjam.com/solutions/founder-led): Founders on camera, directed like a creator.
- [Creative testing](https://hypjam.com/solutions/creative-testing): Hooks × creators × formats, tested one axis at a time.
- [Retention](https://hypjam.com/solutions/retention): How-to, onboarding and reorder video for customers a brand already has.
- [DTC & ecommerce](https://hypjam.com/solutions/dtc-ecommerce): Feed-first ads for brands that sell on the scroll.
- [Apps & subscriptions](https://hypjam.com/solutions/apps-and-subscriptions): Walkthrough and onboarding video for apps people keep opening.
- [Food & drink](https://hypjam.com/solutions/food-and-drink): Kitchen shoots, taste on camera, claims kept inside the rules.
